The '''Side Gunner''', also known as the '''Imperial Side Gunner''', was a model of open [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as well as the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] and and the [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] military. The vehicles were utilized on [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].

The Side Gunner's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] was located in its central car, which sat a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], while the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] sat in a detachable sidecar. It equipped with four [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],<ref name="Catalog" /> two of which were located on the front of the sidecar, one in front of the cockpit, and one mounted on the tip of the vehicle's wing.<ref name="Side Gunner Vehicle" />
